leak.reader: LANDED THE CALL 2026-10-18: VKF-KPV at 72, RDL at 83, gap 11, which is the golden exactly, at about 80 per cent confidence. Question 3 names why: the 695 programme_transition recordings in the archive, "exactly 241 s each", every one starting 30 seconds before a quarter-hour boundary and carrying nothing but the ramp, which it calls built for the analyst. Diagnosis is uniformity rather than single use and is now a rule in dataset-generation section 7: an organ's realism is measured by its variance, not by its genre. Fix is to give the archive its genre's spread (varied lengths, offsets, reasons, some truncated or missing) and make the transition recordings a minority of the file, moving no graded figure.
